name: Aristocrats of Blood
text: You must recruit a Bloodcursed Noble to lead your warband. You begin the campaign with the Opulent Manor stronghold. Your warband can include 0-3 Bloodcursed Knights.

name: Rogue Necromancer
text: You must recruit a Necromancer to lead your warband. You begin the campaign with the Embalmer's Hall stronghold.

name: The Hunt Descends
text: You must recruit a Lycanfell Noble to lead your warband. You begin the campaign with the Grand Pavilion stronghold. Your warband can include any number of Dire Wolves (they do not count towards your Beasts limit).

name: Awakened Lord
text: You must recruit a Barrow Lord to lead your warband. You begin the campaign with the Ancient Barrows stronghold.
